purpose: Teach: 端子/ボルト/区画/キャップ/ポンプ/累積/買取/格納

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 端子製造ラインの品質、見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the quality standards on the terminal production line.
lines.style: Brisk, authoritative opening. Purposeful pace. She's moving through agenda items with practiced confidence. Clear eye contact, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ボルト供給先を多角化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've diversified our bolt suppliers.
lines.style: Cooperative but efficient. Light nod built into the tone. Reporting factually without over-explaining. Warm but businesslike.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 販売区画の見直しを進めましょう
lines.en: Now let's move forward with reviewing the sales divisions.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-moving. Slight lift on 'now'—transition signal. Steady tempo. She's in command without being sharp.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品キャップのデザインを更新しました
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the product cap design.
lines.style: Straightforward update delivery. Matter-of-fact tone. Brief pause before 'design' to let the information land. No pride in it, just completion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ポンプの新規受注を増やしましょう
lines.en: We should increase new orders for the pump line.
lines.style: Measured and goal-oriented. Slight emphasis on 'increase'—it's not optional. Calm authority. She's signaling expectation, not pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。累積売上が目標を超えました
lines.en: Yes. Our accumulated sales have exceeded target.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction underneath. Still professional, but there's a micro-beat of acknowledgment before 'exceeded.' Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中古品買取コーナーを社内に設置しましょう
lines.en: Let's establish a used-item buyback station here in-house.
lines.style: Initiating a new direction. Slight pause before 'let's'—this is a new proposal. Measured pace. Inviting without being uncertain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新書類は専用棚に格納いたします
lines.en: Yes. New documents will be filed on the dedicated shelf.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Crisp, efficient. Final detail handled with quiet precision. Slight trailing acknowledgment—this line concludes the meeting.
